title: Accepted assignment without a revision
journey: A resident compares two repair services.
objective: Prove that an accepted assignment records its reviewed revision.
constraints: Keep the invalid state limited to the accepted revision.

ai_steps.prompt: Inspect the assignment record and list the evidence that supports acceptance.
Check whether the completion record identifies the exact reviewed artifact revision.

deliverables.name: completion-record
deliverables.contents: A completion record tied to the reviewed artifact revision.

acceptance: The reviewed artifact revision is explicit.
learning_check: Explain why acceptance must identify one artifact revision.
handoff: Give the accepted record to the next work unit.
